checks.detail: HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax are always set; Secure is off (HTTP allowed).
checks.fix: Serve over HTTPS and set MEDINEXUS_COOKIE_SECURE=true before going live.

checks.title: Brute-force protection

checks.detail: No account uses the demo password.

checks.title: Security headers
checks.detail: nosniff, frame-deny, no-referrer, no-store and a restrictive Permissions-Policy are sent on every API response; HSTS is added once HTTPS is enabled.

checks.title: No secrets in version control
checks.detail: Scanned 386 tracked files: no API keys. .env is ignored by git.

checks.title: Pseudonymisation key
checks.detail: No platform-wide key yet (it is created on the next dataset upload). The 4 existing sandbox(es) were masked with one-off keys, so their masked identifiers cannot be linked to other uploads.
checks.fix: Re-upload datasets you want to link on masked identifiers.
